en.name: Clasped-hands forward stretch
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand comfortably with your feet apart.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest; interlace your fingers if comfortable.
Gently reach both hands forwards, turning your palms forwards as comfortable. Keep the elbows soft.
Bring the hands back and relax your arms. Breathe normally.
en.focus: Teacher marks one forward reach and return; no wall or equipment is needed.

zh-Hant.name: 十指交扣向前推展
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙手在胸前合起，舒適時可十指交扣。
雙手輕輕向前推展，掌心按舒適程度朝前，手肘不要繃緊。
把雙手收回並放鬆雙臂，保持自然呼吸。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把一次向前推展及收回記作一次，不需要牆壁或器材。
